WITH estado_guardado AS (
  INSERT INTO dz.conversaciones_estado AS actual (
    chatwoot_id,
    conversation_id,
    contact_id,
    inbox_id,
    nombre_cliente,
    telefono_cliente,
    ultimo_message_id,
    ultimo_contacto_at
  )
  VALUES (
    $1::bigint,
    $2::text,
    $3::bigint,
    $4::bigint,
    $5::text,
    $6::text,
    $7::bigint,
    $8::timestamptz
  )
  ON CONFLICT (chatwoot_id)
  DO UPDATE SET
    conversation_id = EXCLUDED.conversation_id,
    contact_id = EXCLUDED.contact_id,
    inbox_id = EXCLUDED.inbox_id,
    nombre_cliente = COALESCE(
      NULLIF(EXCLUDED.nombre_cliente, ''),
      actual.nombre_cliente
    ),
    telefono_cliente = COALESCE(
      NULLIF(EXCLUDED.telefono_cliente, ''),
      actual.telefono_cliente
    ),
    ultimo_message_id = EXCLUDED.ultimo_message_id,
    ultimo_contacto_at = GREATEST(
      actual.ultimo_contacto_at,
      EXCLUDED.ultimo_contacto_at
    ),
    version = actual.version + 1
  WHERE EXCLUDED.ultimo_message_id > actual.ultimo_message_id
  RETURNING *
)
SELECT *
FROM estado_guardado

UNION ALL

SELECT *
FROM dz.conversaciones_estado
WHERE chatwoot_id = $1::bigint
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM estado_guardado
  )

LIMIT 1;

WITH estado_actualizado AS (
  UPDATE dz.conversaciones_estado
  SET
    estado_sofia = 'transferencia_activa',
    motivo_transferencia = $2::text,
    proceso_activo = NULL,
    paso_activo = NULL,
    version = version + 1
  WHERE chatwoot_id = $1::bigint
    AND (
      estado_sofia IS DISTINCT FROM 'transferencia_activa'
      OR motivo_transferencia IS DISTINCT FROM $2::text
    )
  RETURNING *
)
SELECT *
FROM estado_actualizado

UNION ALL

SELECT *
FROM dz.conversaciones_estado
WHERE chatwoot_id = $1::bigint
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM estado_actualizado
  )

LIMIT 1;

WITH actualizado AS (
  UPDATE dz.conversaciones_estado
  SET
    proceso_activo = $2::text,
    paso_activo = $3::text,
    contexto = $4::jsonb,
    version = version + 1
  WHERE chatwoot_id = $1::bigint
    AND ultimo_message_id = $5::bigint
    AND ROW(
      proceso_activo,
      paso_activo,
      contexto
    ) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(
      $2::text,
      $3::text,
      $4::jsonb
    )
  RETURNING *
)
SELECT *
FROM actualizado

UNION ALL

SELECT actual.*
FROM dz.conversaciones_estado AS actual
WHERE actual.chatwoot_id = $1::bigint
  AND actual.ultimo_message_id = $5::bigint
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM actualizado
  )

LIMIT 1;

WITH actualizado AS (
  UPDATE dz.conversaciones_estado
  SET
    proceso_activo = $3::text,
    paso_activo = $4::text,
    contexto =
  (
    COALESCE(contexto, '{}'::jsonb)
    || COALESCE($5::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb)
  )
  || jsonb_build_object(
    'gestion_cita',
    COALESCE(
      contexto -> 'gestion_cita',
      '{}'::jsonb
    )
    ||
    COALESCE(
      $5::jsonb -> 'gestion_cita',
      '{}'::jsonb
    )
  ),
    version = version + 1
  WHERE chatwoot_id = $1::bigint
    AND conversation_id = $2::text
    AND (
      (
        proceso_activo IS NULL
        AND paso_activo IS NULL
      )
      OR
      (
        proceso_activo = $3::text
        AND paso_activo = $4::text
        AND contexto
          -> 'gestion_cita'
          ->> 'cita_id'
          =
          $5::jsonb
          -> 'gestion_cita'
          ->> 'cita_id'
      )
    )
  RETURNING *
)
SELECT *
FROM actualizado

UNION ALL

SELECT actual.*
FROM dz.conversaciones_estado AS actual
WHERE actual.chatwoot_id = $1::bigint
  AND actual.conversation_id = $2::text
  AND actual.proceso_activo = $3::text
  AND actual.paso_activo = $4::text
  AND actual.contexto
    -> 'gestion_cita'
    ->> 'cita_id'
    =
    $5::jsonb
    -> 'gestion_cita'
    ->> 'cita_id'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM actualizado
  )

LIMIT 1;
